title: Count Nodes With the Highest Score
goal: Count nodes whose removal yields the highest product of remaining component sizes.
strategy: Subtree sizes determine every component after removing a node: each child subtree and the remaining parent-side nodes. Multiply only nonempty components using exact integers.
